text: Every kitchen hears the same question, every single night.
What's for dinner?
In this kitchen, the answer started as a list.
Every recipe worth making twice. Learned over the years, cooked for family, and tweaked until it was right.
Pad Thai. Bolognese. Chicken Shawarma. French Onion Soup.
The list kept growing. It still does.
But a list can't tell you what you can cook tonight.
It doesn't know what's in your pantry. And it definitely doesn't know you're out of lemons.
So the list got a kitchen of its own.
One part food. One part humor. All of it built for feeding the family.
This is Dueling Kebabs.
Every dish is on the menu, all in one place.
Browse the whole collection, filter by cuisine, or spin the globe and pick a spot on the map.
Behind the scenes, the staples are already stocked.
Spices, sauces, rice, noodles, and the proteins that always live in the freezer. More than two hundred and fifty of them, loaded in ahead of time.
So the site already knows what's on hand.
Making a meal on the fly? Open, What can I make?
Add anything extra you've got. Say, a can of pineapple juice.
Teriyaki Chicken just made the cut. Everything you can cook right now goes to the top, and the near misses tell you exactly what they're missing.
Just visiting? No account needed. Type in what you have, and it works the same way.
Planning a quick shopping trip for one dish? Open the recipe, and flip, Can I cook this?
What you have turns green. What you need turns red.
For Chicken Shawarma, it's a lemon. Shopping list: done.
And when nobody can decide, hit Surprise me, and let the reel pick dinner.
Dueling Kebabs. Every dish worth cooking, one menu away.
Down with hunger.
